label: Fundamentals, Architecture & Operations
desc: 13 interview questions covering Fundamentals, Backup & Recovery.

subs.label: Fundamentals
subs.desc: Bigtable is commonly used for storing and analyzing large amounts of time-series data, as well as for serving real-time applications.

subs.label: Backup & Recovery
subs.desc: Bigtable provides built-in backup and restore functionality, allowing you to create backups and restore data to a specific point in time.

label: Schema Design & Data Model
desc: 25 interview questions covering Data Model, Schema, Partitioning.

subs.label: Data Model
subs.desc: Bigtable stores data as byte arrays, allowing developers to interpret the data in any structured format they desire.

subs.label: Schema
subs.desc: Bigtable is schema-less, meaning that new columns can be added to the table without affecting existing rows.

subs.label: Partitioning
subs.desc: Does Bigtable support automatic data partitioning?

label: Performance & Scaling
desc: 26 interview questions covering Performance, Compaction, Bloom Filter, Storage Internals and more.

subs.label: Performance
subs.desc: Bigtable provides built-in support for data compression, allowing you to save storage space and improve read and write performance.

subs.label: Compaction
subs.desc: Compaction is the process of merging smaller sorted files into larger ones to improve storage efficiency.

subs.label: Bloom Filter
subs.desc: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic data structure used by Bigtable to reduce disk I/O by filtering out irrelevant data during read operations.

subs.label: Storage Internals
subs.desc: Bigtable's memstore is an in-memory data structure that temporarily holds recently written data before flushing it to disk.

subs.label: Partitioning
subs.desc: Bigtable partitions data by range partitioning the row keys, and it automatically balances the distribution of tablets across tablet servers to ensure load balancing.

subs.label: Replication
subs.desc: Bigtable provides high availability through replication and automatic failover mechanisms, ensuring continuous access to data even in case of server or region failures.

subs.label: Consistency
subs.desc: Bigtable provides "eventual consistency," meaning that data may not be immediately consistent across all replicas but will eventually converge.

label: Security & Access Control
desc: 8 interview questions covering Access Control, Encryption.

subs.label: Access Control
subs.desc: Bigtable integrates with Google Cloud IAM (Identity and Access Management) to provide fine-grained access control and security policies.

subs.label: Encryption
subs.desc: Bigtable encrypts data at rest using Google Cloud's default encryption, and it supports client-side encryption for additional security.

subs.label: Ecosystem
subs.desc: Bigtable provides client libraries for different programming languages, such as Java, Python, and Go, to interact with the database.

subs.label: ML
subs.desc: Does Bigtable support integration with machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch?
